# WaferScaleSystem

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-13

## Definition
A computing architecture integrating multiple chiplets and components on a single wafer-scale substrate for high-density interconnectivity. Enables massive parallelism and reduced communication latency critical for topology-centric computing at scale.
